episode.episode_title: OpenCode's Console breach: Who needs to act?

short.title: OpenCode Console breach: what is confirmed?
short.description: OpenCode reports that 1.4% of Console users were affected. Here is what is known, what is not, and targeted steps for notified users. Read Sapiver Forge: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: OpenCode reports a breach affecting 1.4 per cent of its Console users, specifically accounts linked to external model providers. It says affected users were emailed. If you received that notice, revoke linked API keys and check provider usage. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
